text: I. Professional OverviewDesign studies are an important discipline in undergraduate and postgraduate education at ordinary universities in China, belonging to the category of Art Studies (subject code 1305). The usual duration of study is 4 years (for undergraduate programs), and a Bachelor of Arts degree is awarded. The postgraduate stage is divided into master's and doctoral levels, with more specialized research directions.This major focuses on "design" as its core, studying the principles, methods, history, and practical applications of design. It emphasizes the concept of "people-oriented", and pays attention to integrating aesthetic value, functional requirements, technical feasibility, and social culture. It aims to cultivate professional talents with innovative design capabilities, interdisciplinary thinking, and practical skills.II. Training ObjectivesUndergraduate level: Cultivate students who master the basic theories, knowledge, and skills of design studies, possess strong innovative consciousness and practical abilities, and can engage in design creation, research, teaching, or management in various design fields.Postgraduate level: Focus on cultivating academic research capabilities or advanced design practical abilities, concentrating on specific specialized fields (such as design theory, sustainable design, interaction design, etc.), and be capable of undertaking complex design projects or academic research work.
